name: Chiss merchant ship
description: The Chiss merchant ship was a class of merchant starship used by the Unknown Regions Chiss Ascendancy nation. By 36 BBY, the Pathfinder navigator Qilori had served as the navigator for a number of Chiss merchant ships. In that year, he served as the navigator for a Chiss diplomatic cruiser, and privately remarked that the bridge was identical to every Chiss merchant ship he had navigated.
